regulation_name: Draft Guidance for Reducing Risk From Perfluorooctanoic Acid (PFOA) and Perfluorooctane Sulfonic Acid (PFOS) in Biosolids; Establishment of a Public Docket; Request for Feedback
summary: Not applicable: Even if finalized, the guidance provides only non-binding, voluntary recommendations regarding PFOA and PFOS in biosolids and creates no new obligations for hog farm operations.
